name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump to Nominate Hung Cao as Navy Secretary
changes.summary: The announcement came amid a purge of leadership at the Pentagon and a stalling war effort against Iran.

changes.title: ICE detainee dies just hours after he was admitted into detention
changes.summary: Lianyong Wei's death marks the 57th death of an immigrant detainee held in the care of the government since the start of President Trump's second term. Twenty-four of those have occurred since Jan. 1. (Image credit: Heather Diehl).

changes.title: Trump attempts to combat high gas prices as affordability crisis looms over midterms
changes.summary: President Trump seems to be pulling out all the stops to mitigate high gas prices ahead of the midterms.

changes.title: Political consultant on how the cost-of-living is affecting Trump's approval rating
changes.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with political consultant Sarah Longwell about Trump's low approval rating and high gas prices, as affordability shadows the approaching midterm election.

changes.title: Susan Collins on Trump, tariffs and the state of her senate race over Maine lobsters
changes.summary: Susan Collins on Trump, tariffs and the state of her senate race over Maine lobsters lead image.

changes.title: Republicans aren’t exactly flocking to Trump’s midterm convention
changes.summary: President Donald Trump has a vision for next week’s GOP convention in Dallas: a televised spectacle putting Republican candidates in front of midterm voters and top party donors just two months before the Election Day — with Trump himself headlining the show. changes.title: Kennedy Center Begins Removing Outdoor ‘Blue’ Sculpture
changes.summary: The towering artwork, added to the campus in 2019, was targeted for elimination after President Trump’s takeover of the center.

changes.title: On Trump’s Ballroom, Chief Justice Finds Himself in an Unusual Spot: In Dissent
changes.summary: Chief Justice John G. Roberts Jr. has been in the majority in divided cases more times than any other chief since 1953. But not this time.

changes.title: Trump Returns to a Familiar Playbook as the War With Iran Flares Up Again
changes.summary: President Trump called on Iranians to “rise up and fight” on Tuesday as the United States seems increasingly bogged down after six months of conflict.

changes.title: Who Approves Trump’s Washington Makeover Projects?
changes.summary: The Supreme Court gave a green light to the new White House ballroom, but several of the president’s other Washington projects remain stalled.
